name: Space Mission
author: Pinetreebricks
description: Make your way across an alien planet, but be sure to watch out for the rocks! they're not as friendly as they seem.                                                                      .                                                                                                                                                        This is my first LEGO microgame and I recognize the issues it still has but I am proud of what I made as this is the first time I have ever done anything like this.
